# Accessibility

This repository is a backup of the articles on Ferran Buireu's [Hashnode blog](https://hashnode.com/@Buireu), one
Markdown file per article, written here by Hashnode's GitHub integration. No article is edited by hand here: an
article is fixed on Hashnode, and the next sync brings the fix here.

## What the backups offer

Each article is plain Markdown: headings, lists, links and code blocks that GitHub renders as text, readable with a
screen reader and at any zoom. Images carry the alt text the article has on Hashnode.

## Known barriers

This repository has no issue tracker, so its known barriers are listed here.

- In *What is Redux? Do I need to use it?*, three images have alt text that names them without describing them.
  *Uncle Ben's quote* does not give the quote. *Redux state sample* and *Redux workflow* do not describe their
  diagrams, although the text beside each one explains the same flow.
- Two images in that article and one in the Astro breadcrumb article are animated GIFs. GitHub's accessibility
  settings can stop animated images from playing on their own.

## Reporting a barrier

[Open a bug report in the profile repository](https://github.com/fbuireu/fbuireu/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
and name the article, or leave a comment on the article on Hashnode. You don't need to say anything about a
disability. Include what you were trying to read, what got in the way, and any assistive technology or settings
you use, such as a screen reader, zoom or reduced motion.

A fix is made in the article on Hashnode and reaches this backup with the next sync, and the list above loses that
barrier once it has. No date is promised for it.

## Ownership

Ferran Buireu writes the articles and maintains this page.
